processors.title: Reminder sender
processors.description: Every minute, takes each loan from "Overdue loans to remind", sends the member a reminder, then records it with SendReminder. The external system is a fake mailer: it only writes one log line per reminder (Logger.info "Reminder sent: member M-1042, book <bookId>, loan <loanId>"), so the example runs without credentials. If the mailer fails, nothing is recorded and the loan stays in the queue for the next poll.
